newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline drifts sideways in slow market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline drifts sideways in slow market.

text.p: NWE gasoline got off to a slow start at the end of the week with levels unchanged from Thursday, dealers said on Friday.
Physical eurograde barges were ranged between $187-189 with regular pegged at about $181.

With the arb to the U.S. still shut dealers said prompt supplies were starting to exert a bearish undertone. The window for shifting material ahead of the July 2 U.K. budget, which is expected to increase excise duty on gasoline, now looks shut.
